title: reg V is relatively open in spt V (Simon 5.7.2 remark)
statement: For every n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and every rectifiable n-varifold V in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), there is an open set O ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with reg V = O ∩ spt V, where spt V = V.support and reg V = V.regularSet = {ξ ∈ spt V : B̆_ρ(ξ) ∩ spt V is an n-dimensional C¹ submanifold for some ρ > 0}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), ∃ O : Set (Amb n ℓ), IsOpen O ∧ V.regularSet = O ∩ V.support
